title: One tool call
intro: The model can return a tool call instead of text: the name of a function and its arguments. Your program runs that function once. It does not call the model again.

steps.author: system
steps.label: System
steps.narration: The system message tells the model to use the weather tool. The tool schema, sent with the request, names get_weather and its city argument.

steps.author: user
steps.label: User
steps.narration: The user asks for weather in Paris. One chat.completions.create sends the messages and the tool schema together.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call
steps.narration: The model does not fetch weather. It returns a tool call: the name get_weather and the argument city=Paris. Your code has not run yet.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.narration: Your program runs get_weather(city="Paris") and prints the dict it returned. There is no second model call, so the model never sees this result.
